remarks: Multiple Offers. Highest & Best due no later than 12pm on Monday July 7th. Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this sun-filled 3-bedroom, 2-bath ranch-style home offers the ideal combination of comfort, space, and convenience. With an open floor plan, hardwood floors throughout, and a layout that effortlessly supports both everyday living and entertaining, this home checks every box for today's discerning buyer. At the heart of the home is the updated eat-in kitchen featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances - including a new refrigerator/freezer and new dishwasher - a center island, and a gas cooktop. The kitchen opens seamlessly to the oversized family room with a cozy fireplace, as well as to the dining room, which features sliding doors leading to a spacious wooden deck - perfect for grilling and outdoor entertaining. All three bedrooms are located on the main level, including a generously sized primary suite with a walk-in closet and full bath. Two additional bedrooms and an updated hallway bathroom complete the main floor. The finished walkout lower level offers even more living space with new luxury vinyl plank flooring, a large recreation room, and a versatile den or office - ideal for today's work-from-home needs. Additional highlights include a two-car attached garage, Nest thermostat, security system, newer central A/C, underground sprinklers, and a fully fenced-in backyard.
